title: tfm-churn-profit-audit: code, per-split predictions and paper for "Do Tabular Foundation Models Pay Off for Churn?"
description: Code, released per-split predictions and LaTeX source for the paper Do Tabular Foundation Models Pay Off for Churn? A Profit-, Calibration- and Tuning-Aware Re-evaluation. The study compares TabPFN-2.5, TabPFN-3.5, TabPFN-3.5-Fast and TabICL v2 with Optuna-tuned LightGBM, XGBoost and CatBoost on five public telecom churn datasets. Models are scored on ranking metrics, expected maximum profit (EMP), e-Profits, a fixed-threshold campaign policy, calibration and scoring time, with paired-bootstrap intervals. The archive contains the Kaggle prediction and analysis code (as scripts and notebooks), the predictions and split indices of all 315 runs, the analysis outputs, and the manuscript with its table generator and audit. Dataset values are not redistributed.
